items.html:
Governing Features

Reviewed the committed Python/API/documentation changes for physics-first setup, explicit framework differentiation, migration clarity, and truthful qualification claims.

File Narratives

  • _physics.py provides NumPy constructors, explicit cluster solves, and periodic response conversion.
  • _framework.py implements shared differentiable physical objects; advect.py, jax.py, and torch.py select execution.
  • support.py extracts installed contracts; generate_agent_docs.py produces docs/api.md and llms.txt.
  • User guides explain physical workflows; status and campaign reports distinguish numerical qualification from agent outcomes.

Documentation Issues / Feature Mismatches

P2 — [docs-conflict] Framework cylinders lack the documented cross_widths operation. docs/user-guide.md:38–40 directs cylinder users to cross_widths, and the adapter documentation presents the same physical vocabulary. However, every framework cylinder returns _framework.TMatrix, which only supplies cross_sections (python/treams_rs/_framework.py:681–691). That method switches to length-valued cylinder results internally. Following the documented cylinder workflow after selecting an autodiff namespace therefore raises AttributeError; choosing cross_sections instead introduces an undocumented units/name difference. Small fix: expose the cylinder spelling through the shared implementation, or explicitly document this framework exception and its length units.

P2 — [docs-conflict] Public S-matrix signatures identify the wrong returned physical type. python/treams_rs/_smatrix.py:146 annotates block(...) -> SMatrix, but this internal class is now publicly exported as ScatteringBlock. Consequently, the generated reference advertises treams_rs.SMatrix.block(...) -> SMatrix, falsely identifying a single block as the complete network. Likewise, cascade advertises the removed public name SMatrices (:183). These are consequential discovery errors precisely at the redesigned network/block boundary. Resolve source annotations to public names in the source/catalog path and regenerate documentation; do not hand-edit docs/api.md.

Comparable Files / Boundaries

Compared NumPy and framework response APIs, root re-exports, installed CLI lookup, generated signatures, executable documentation tests, and campaign qualification wording. The two findings concern these cross-file contracts; no additional ownership, abstraction, or ordering changes recommended.

No Findings

Campaign reporting correctly states 118/120 versus 110/120, separates confirmation from fresh transfer, discloses the missed 40% time gate, and does not transfer historical numerical/performance qualification to this revision.

Read-only inspection only; no tests or builds run, no files or Git/GitHub state changed.
